title: One-way rules
description: Whether a rental picked up at one branch may be returned at another, and the fee; a product rule overrides the generic one.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view one-way rules.
load_failed: One-way rules could not be loaded.
empty_description: Routes without a rule do not allow one-way returns.
fields.rental_product_hint: Empty means every product; a product rule takes precedence.
fields.allowed_hint: When off, this route cannot be used one-way.
drawer.description: Routes are directional: A → B and B → A are separate rules.
validation.same_branch: The return branch must differ from the pick-up branch.
validation.fee: Enter a valid amount (at most 2 decimals).
